main_visual_task: Show one real water drop physically wetting coarse coffee grounds while the camera performs one unmistakable continuous slow push-in.

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same bed of coarse dark-roasted coffee grounds and one clear cold-water drop
prompt_bible.environment_lock: dark walnut tabletop, seamless black background, no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: real coarse coffee grounds, transparent water, visibly wet porous coffee granules, a small dark coffee pool
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: fixed warm side backlight from upper right and faint cool fill from left
prompt_bible.palette_lock: espresso brown, walnut brown, warm amber highlights and black
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal 100mm macro cinema lens, natural granular texture, no CGI geometry
prompt_bible.screen_direction: the water falls straight downward at frame center; never reverse direction
prompt_bible.audio_policy: one close water drop and quiet room tone

timeline.visual_state: a broad field of dry coarse coffee grounds is visible with one clear drop above center
timeline.subject_action: the drop descends slowly toward the grounds
timeline.camera_action: begin one continuous very slow dolly-in toward the center contact point
timeline.lighting_state: fixed warm rim and cool fill

timeline.visual_state: the broad grounds field remains visible
timeline.subject_action: the drop touches, flattens and enters visible gaps without splashing
timeline.camera_action: continue the same forward dolly-in at constant direction and slow speed
timeline.end_state: an irregular dark wet patch appears

timeline.visual_state: the wet patch occupies more of the frame because the camera is closer
timeline.subject_action: capillary wetting spreads between separate granules and makes them progressively darker
timeline.camera_action: continue only the same straight optical-axis push-in toward the fixed contact point
timeline.focus: leading wet edge and connected micro-channels
timeline.end_state: thin dark liquid channels connect inside the wet patch

timeline.visual_state: the camera is now very close to the connected wet region
timeline.subject_action: small liquid channels merge into one physically small coffee pool
timeline.camera_action: finish the same straight push-in and begin gentle deceleration
timeline.end_state: small continuous dark coffee pool fills the center

timeline.visual_state: stable macro view of the small coffee pool among still-recognizable grounds
timeline.subject_action: tiny ripples settle without new splashes
timeline.camera_action: camera completes the push-in and stops
timeline.focus: locked on pool highlight and wet granular edge

camera_plan.motivation: move the viewer physically closer to inspect the exact capillary wetting process
camera_plan.start_position: macro close-up twenty centimeters above a broad grounds field
camera_plan.path: move straight forward toward the fixed center contact point and end ten centimeters closer without lateral motion
camera_plan.speed_curve: one constant very slow forward move, then decelerate during the final second
camera_plan.focus_transition: broad grounds and drop to contact edge to micro-channels to small liquid pool
camera_plan.end_position: extreme macro centered on the wet edge and small coffee pool
camera_plan.axis_lock: straight optical-axis push only; water remains centered and falls downward
camera_plan.stop_condition: stop after the small pool ripple settles

first_frame: broad close-up field of coarse coffee grounds with one water drop above center
last_frame: extreme macro of a small stable coffee pool surrounded by recognizable wet grounds
